result.cause: The runtime inherited the daemon ST_AGENT value, and the literal local judge placement did not match the daemon node.
evidence: Both Claude agents published harness.ready claims.
The supervisor received the pinned task document and delegated through an st3 channel notification.
The worker committed the correct MIT license change and sent a detailed report.
The report claim used the daemon's ambient identity instead of agent/mix.worker, so the completion judge correctly did not pass.
The mechanical judges used host local, but the planner did not resolve local to the receiving daemon node.
The supervisor sent one verified confirmation and correctly refused a second confirmation during recovery.

fix.description: The reconciler sets ST_AGENT to the graph subject, and normalization resolves local placement to the receiving node.
